metadata.name: Anthropic
metadata.description: Pre-IPO perpetuals track a private company's market cap, because share counts in private financing rounds are uncertain. Each $1 of a pre-IPO perpetual represents $1B of that market cap. Phoenix does not yet support share splits, so pre-IPO perpetual markets whose per-share value differs substantially from one billionth of the market cap will close after the IPO. On the date of the IPO, Phoenix will create a new real-world asset market pegged to the value of 1 share. After 1 day, Phoenix will close existing positions on the pre-IPO market at mark price and close that market. A pre-IPO perpetual is not equity and conveys no ownership, voting rights, dividends, information rights, IPO allocation, or claim on the issuer. Holders have no relationship with the referenced company. Phoenix is an independent platform and has no affiliation, partnership, endorsement, or formal relationship with the referenced company.
